A '''war''' between the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Garos IV]] and [[Sundari (planet)|Sundari]] was ongoing during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Representatives of one of the galactic powers negotiated the [[Sundari–Garos Accord]], ending the war and gaining access to the planets' fossil fuel reserves.<ref name="The Sundari-Garos Accord">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|The Sundari-Garos Accord}}</ref>
